label: LDL cholesterol
note: EHR lab: many values per person over years, and REAL analyses must also restrict units (mg/dL) -- this teaching pass relies on plausibility bounds alone. Direct and calculated LDL are separate concepts.

note: EHR lab -- same caveats as LDL. LOINC 2085-9.
